item.title: "Success is built off the mat too," says Noida Ninjas owner Deepak Nagar in UPKL Season 2

item.title: WPL 2026: Gujarat Giants start campaign with win over UP Warriorz
item.description: Gujarat Giants beat the UP Warriorz by ten runs.

item.title: AIFF moves to operationalise ISL 2025–26, sets deadline for club confirmations
item.description: Clubs have been asked to confirm their home venue details by 12 noon on January 12, a step AIFF said is essential to finalise fixtures.

item.title: Jadumani Singh claims maiden Senior National Boxing Gold
item.description: Services boxers finished top with 12 gold medals as Jadumani Singh outclassed Pawan Bartwal in a keenly awaited national final.

item.title: WTT Feeder Vadodara: Unseeded Anusha Kutumbale extends fairytale run to semis
item.description: Anusha Kutumbale stunned fourth seed Yashaswini Ghorpade to reach the women’s singles semifinals of the WTT Feeder Series 2026.

item.title: Coca-Cola named official sponsor of Indian women’s football team
item.description: The landmark partnership offers long-term backing to the Indian women’s team ahead of major continental competitions after a breakthrough 2025 season.

item.title: Bengaluru Open 2026: Pedro Martinez lifts singles crown
item.description: Top seed Pedro Martinez sealed the Bengaluru Open title with a composed straight-sets win to earn 125 ATP points.

item.title: SG Pipers clinch Women’s HIL 2025–26 title
item.description: SG Pipers edged Shrachi Bengal Tigers in a tense shootout after a 1-1 draw to lift the Women’s Hero Hockey India League trophy in Ranchi.

item.title: WPL 2026: Reigning champs Mumbai Indians open account with win over Delhi Capitals
item.description: Nat Sciver-Brunt, Harmanpreet Kaur, and Nicola Carey starred for Mumbai Indians in their 50-run win.

item.title: His game defined, Manav Thakkar now in search of mastery
item.description: With a commendable display at 2026 WTT Champions Doha, Manav Thakkar is on the right track, believes coach Massimo Costantini.
